Contemptful staff, dishonest practice
Apr 2026 • Couples
Cocktail with little alcohol and with 15-20% taxes added to the bill. We forget to return the money if you do not ask. 

We expected to be 70k, and we are given a 5k after claim without explanation, no excuse for forgetting. In asking for an explanation, contemptuous behaviour on the part of the staff, especially the one who handles the caisse, is unacceptable. 
I felt insulted when she said “it’s clearly written here”, pointing to a sentence on the front page of the menu, in small print. 
On the receipt, the more widely displayed price is still the one excluding taxes and just after the price with taxes but in a different font. This still causes confusion. 

Even if it is a street practice, it would be a matter of being honest and putting the real price with taxes included or mentioning on each page that it will be necessary to include taxes. 

The problem is not the price, but the fact that we are mistaken for idiots, and that they try to surround us with insignificant mentions compared to a gigantic map
